figurative_meaning_en: To make a draft, plan, or estimate for a task
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রকল্প শুরু করার আগে ভালো করে ছক কেটে নাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Sketch out the plan properly before starting the project.
It's essential to map out the business strategy.
note: Idiom derives from the idea of drawing a grid or outline, common in Bengali administrative and planning contexts.
